snippet.title: Age of the Ring 10.0 Launcher & Campaign Overview
snippet.description:
Welcome to an overview of the brand-new campaign launcher features coming in Age of the Ring Version 10.0!

In this video, we take a closer look at the dedicated Campaign Tab and the major quality-of-life additions arriving with the 10.0 update—including custom difficulty options, in-depth objective tracking, save generation tools, and checkpoint systems.

Release Date: Version 10.0 launches October 31st!

Download AotR 9.0 now:
